spans.text: The Commander and company tear through the streets in a frenzy, desperately searching for their destination⁠—a bar named "Athena's Owl".
I'm doomed I'm doomed I'm doomed I'm doomed!
Commander, Commander, Commander! Over here, over here! Over hereeee!
What kind of crappy bar is this?! Why is it so damn hard to find?! My pillow would be better at running a business than the boss of this place!
"Athena's Owl" suddenly looms into view in front of everyone.
The Commander charges inside without a second thought.
